text: So sorry to bother you, I'm a childminder and I've still got a little boy here, 20 months, as his mum's stuck at work. I think he's getting poorly, his temp is 38.3. He won't take anything at all, not his milk or water or juice, he's pushing every cup away and hasn't had a drink for hours. I also noticed some little purplish dots on his chest and I did the glass test and I don't think they're fading, they still show through the glass. I might be wrong as the light isn't great but they don't seem to go. I've called his mum. Sorry again, I just wasn't sure what to do.
